title: 2 Right-Wingers Who Broke With Netanyahu Could Bid to Unseat Him
summary_full: The political evolutions of Naftali Bennett, a former prime minister, and Avigdor Liberman, a former defense minister, are indicative of how Benjamin Netanyahu has polarized Israel.
